articles.title: AI exposed a massive flaw in top crypto network and experts warn banks could be next
articles.snippet: After an AI model helped uncover a four-year-old flaw in Zcash, security researchers warn that similar bugs may be hiding across crypto and traditional financial systems.

articles.title: U.S. House tax committee weighs crypto bills, including relief for small transactions
articles.snippet: Seven draft bills are being circulated by the House Ways and Means Committee ahead of a hearing next week, including proposals to ease small-gain, mining and staking burdens.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bitcoin (BTC) price drops 2.8% as index declines
articles.snippet: All twenty constituents in the CoinDesk 20 index were trading lower since yesterday.

articles.title: Bearish zcash bets hit record high as privacy token's price crashes
articles.snippet: Liquidations were small relative to the size of the decline, pointing to spot selling rather than a leverage cascade, while open interest in ZEC futures climbed to a record high in token terms as traders crowded into the slide from the short side.
